do_not_assume: A transaction has only one account.
goal: Account for a gift from donor action through its Rock records and reporting treatment.
steps: Record the entry surface, date, intended person or business, amount, and intended account without collecting payment secrets.
Inspect the page’s gateway, transaction type, source, account, batch-prefix, and receipt settings.
Determine whether processing is immediate, future-dated, or recurring.
Confirm gateway outcome using a safe provider reference.
Locate the Rock transaction and inspect all transaction details.
Confirm the account on each detail and the sum of the allocations.
Locate the batch and compare status, totals, control values, account totals, and currency totals.
Check receipt configuration and evidence independently.
Reproduce any report or statement with its exact inclusion rules.
Record which links were observed and which remain unverified.
title: Recipe: Trace a public gift end to end

do_not_assume: A gateway named “Test” is harmless if it has been reconfigured.
An active gateway is selected by the page.
A successful confirmation page proves downstream records.
goal: Establish that the page’s configuration expresses the intended finance path.
steps: Identify the installed Rock version and exact Utility Payment Entry or legacy block.
Verify the gateway and whether its mode represents test/live or hosted/unhosted.
Confirm enabled payment methods.
Confirm transaction type, source, accounts, campus mapping, and scheduled-giving option.
Confirm batch prefix and gateway batch timing.
Confirm business, anonymous, CAPTCHA, confirmation-page, and receipt settings as applicable.
Execute an authorized non-production test.
Verify the gateway result, Rock transaction, details, account, batch, receipt behavior, and visible giving history.
title: Recipe: Validate an online giving page before launch

do_not_assume: Do not treat generated guidance as live-instance proof.
goal: Explain every batch total and variance at the correct grain.
steps: Confirm batch status; wait for an automated pending batch to complete.
Record the transaction total, control amount, and amount variance.
Record transaction count, control count, and count variance.
Review transaction details for split-account gifts.
Compare account and currency totals.
Resolve unmatched imported items through the intended matching workflow.
Review the audit log for edits.
Compare the reconciled batch total with the external settlement or general-ledger handoff according to the organization’s documented process.
title: Recipe: Reconcile an online batch

do_not_assume: Family membership alone determines the giving unit.
Web and PDF output are visually identical.
goal: Produce a reviewable statement set whose population and finance rules are explicit.
steps: Verify Statement Generator compatibility, user role, and Rock version.
Select the population and decide how inactive people and businesses are handled.
Review family and individual giving-unit settings for exceptions.
Copy or select a contribution template.
Verify accounts, currency types, transaction types, refund rules, same-day corrections, and pledge settings.
Set period, minimum contribution, suppression behavior, sort, split, and output settings.
Generate single-person samples representing family, individual, business, refund, non-cash, and pledge scenarios that actually apply.
Compare each sample with underlying transaction details.
Run the full generation.
Preserve and review the generated summary separately from printing or delivery.
title: Recipe: Generate and validate contribution statements

do_not_assume: `GROUP BY` and a window function preserve the same rows.
One transaction equals one account allocation.
A report creator’s permission protects report viewers.
goal: Show each account allocation with transaction-level context without accidental row collapse.
steps: Define whether the output grain is transaction, transaction detail, giving unit, person, family, registration, registrant, or batch.
Begin with the entity that represents that grain.
For detail-level reporting, retain one row per financial transaction detail.
Use `OVER (PARTITION BY TransactionId)` when transaction totals or detail counts must appear beside each detail.
Add ranking functions only when the report requires sequence, rank, or buckets.
Test a transaction split across multiple accounts.
Compare the sum of detail rows with the expected transaction and batch totals.
Secure the report and every page or dashboard that exposes it.
title: Recipe: Build a detail-preserving finance report

do_not_assume: Changing Give Now migrates existing schedules.
Making the old gateway inactive stops every assigned charge.
Gateway-held payment credentials can be exported.
goal: Route new gifts to the new provider while giving existing scheduled donors a controlled transfer path.
steps: Verify the installed block generation and gateway-provider support.
Configure and test the new gateway without modifying the Test Gateway into a live gateway.
Change the Give Now surface so new profiles use the new gateway.
Configure the Manage Giving Profiles surface to identify old-gateway profiles and offer transfer.
Test the transfer with an authorized non-production profile.
Verify creation of the replacement profile and deletion of the old profile only after completion.
Track remaining old-gateway profiles without exposing payment data.
Keep the old gateway available only as required by the migration and provider plan.
title: Recipe: Transfer scheduled giving to a new gateway
